source_handling: AST located selftrained APIs before exact method reads. Named original JSON files were inspected by top-level types and fixed raw-measurement/provenance projections. No notes/review/scope-correction result interpretations were read. General method restrictions and annotation contracts were distinguished from authored verdicts.
scope_limits: No formal training, GPU, Modal invocation, paid execution, external writes or publication.
No whole-course gate, full kernel sweep, live website desktop/mobile audit or real Colab runtime check.
Existing v2 measurements were re-counted from originals and preserved by SHA; they are not new training/evaluation results.
Historical MPS job/status/source checked; this Linux host only executed CPU.
README links and roadmap were reviewed as orientation; detailed chapter scientific claims remain their own review units.
